title: CTann Supertree v10
subtitle: What this supertree is and what the other tabs show

params.heading: CTann Supertree v10
intro: The CTann Supertree is built from 10 annotation crosswalks listed [here](https://apps.humanatlas.io/kg-explorer/?do=ctann). Where CL annotations had multiple parentage, a single hierarchical path was selected based on the parentage leading to the designated top-level cell type, rather than representing all possible parent paths, to maintain a consistent and non-redundant tree structure. More details at: [https://github.com/cns-iu/hra-ctann-supporting-information/blob/main/README.md](https://github.com/cns-iu/hra-ctann-supporting-information/blob/main/README.md)
The CTann Supertree provides a framework to evaluate and contrast the coverage offered by various CTann tools and methodologies.

sections.label: Reference Supertree
sections.text: The CTann Supertree with all 10 crosswalks overlaid. Each node is represented by a color coded bar that indicates what CTann tool lists this cell type in its crosswalk.

sections.label: HRApop Comparison
sections.text: Supports a direct comparison of cell types represented in the CTann Supertree with those identified by Azimuth (red) and Pan-Human Azimuth (blue) for lung single-cell transcriptomics data from HRApop v1.1 outputs.

sections.label: HLCA Node Comparison
sections.text: Extending the comparison between Azimuth and Pan-Human Azimuth, this tab compares Azimuth and Pan-Human Azimuth predictions with original author annotations in the HLCA dataset from HRApop v1.1 outputs.

sections.label: Tool Agreement
sections.text: This view evaluates agreement among five CTann tools—Azimuth, CellTypist, FR-Match, Pan-Human Azimuth, and popV—using HRApop v1.1 lung sc-transcriptomics data.
